title: Pithoragarh Uttarakhand | Best Places to Visit, Things to Do & Travel Guide
content:
Pithoragarh - Uttarkhand,

Pithoragarh, often called the “Little Kashmir of Kumaon,” is a serene hill town nestled in the easternmost corner of Uttarakhand. Surrounded by the towering Himalayan peaks, dense forests, and terraced farmlands, this town has a charm that feels untouched by time.

The town is famous for its historic forts, temples, and traditional Kumaoni architecture. One of the highlights is the Pithoragarh Fort, which offers stunning views of the town and surrounding valleys. The Kathgodam – Pithoragarh route winds through picturesque villages and green hills, making the journey as enjoyable as the destination itself.

Pithoragarh is also the starting point for many treks and nature trails. From here, travelers can explore Askot Wildlife Sanctuary, Chhangru Village, and high-altitude villages leading to glaciers and Himalayan passes. Unlike crowded tourist spots, Pithoragarh offers peace, raw natural beauty, and a chance to experience Kumaoni culture closely.

Whether you’re a history buff, trekker, or someone looking for calm mountain air, Pithoragarh has something for everyone. It’s an ideal base for exploring the eastern Kumaon region while enjoying Himalayan views, local cuisine, and traditional handicrafts.

Location (Distance from City Center):

  • From Delhi: 550 km (approx. 14 hours by road).
  • From Almora: 185 km.
  • From Kathgodam Railway Station: 200 km.

🎟️ Entry Fee / Ticket:

  • Visiting Pithoragarh town and forts is mostly free.
  • Entry to wildlife sanctuaries or guided treks may have small fees (₹50 - ₹200).

Best Time to Visit:

  • March - June: Pleasant weather, ideal for sightseeing and trekking (12°C - 25°C).
  • July - September: Monsoon season, lush green valleys, but slippery roads (10°C - 20°C).
  • October - November: Clear skies and crisp mountain air, perfect for photography (8°C - 18°C).
  • December - February: Cold winter with occasional snowfall in high-altitude areas (0°C - 10°C).

Things to Do in Pithoragarh:

  • Explore Pithoragarh Fort for panoramic valley views.
  • Visit Askot Wildlife Sanctuary to see Himalayan fauna and birds.
  • Stroll through local markets for handicrafts, woolens, and Kumaoni cuisine.
  • Trek to Chhangru Village for traditional Kumaoni lifestyle and Himalayan views.
  • Discover ancient temples scattered around the town.
  • Enjoy nature walks along terraced fields and pine forests.

Top 10 Places to Visit Near Pithoragarh (within 50 km):

1- Munsiyari (50 km) – Gateway for trekking and glaciers.

2- Askot Wildlife Sanctuary (20 km) – Protected Himalayan flora and fauna.

3- Chhangru Village (15 km) – Peaceful high-altitude village with views.

4- Dharchula (50 km) – Border town with scenic Himalayan rivers.

5- Gwaldam (40 km) – Small hill town with trekking trails.

6- Jauljibi (45 km) – Scenic river confluence and local markets.

7- Jhulaghat (50 km) – Tiny border town with unique cultural experiences.

8- Supin Village (25 km) – Traditional Kumaoni village life.

9- Munsyari Meadows (50 km) – Lush meadows and mountain backdrop.

10- Patal Bhuvaneshwar (50 km) – Limestone cave temple with legends.
excerpt: Pithoragarh, the “Little Kashmir of Kumaon,” is a serene Himalayan town perfect for trekking, nature walks, historic forts, and exploring Kumaoni culture. A must-visit for travelers seeking peace and adventure.
